title: "Ziang Zhang"
---

Hi! I'm Ziang Zhang, an M.S. student in Biostatistics at Columbia University (expected May 2028). Before Columbia, I earned a B.S. in Applied Mathematics and Biology from Emory University.

I'm interested in health data science: building data pipelines and validation checks that make analyses reproducible, and using statistical models to answer clinical and public health questions.

### On this site

* [Resume](resume.html): my education, experience, and projects
* [Dashboard](dashboard.html): an interactive look at daily temperatures from NOAA weather stations in New York, built with `flexdashboard` and `plotly`
* [Shiny App](shiny.html): an R Shiny explorer for coronary heart disease risk and prevalence in NHANES

### Selected projects

* [Travel Atlas](https://ziang-atlas.pages.dev): an interactive map of places I have visited, built on a validated data pipeline ([GitHub](https://github.com/Markholmezza/travel-atlas))
* [Coronary heart disease risk model](https://github.com/Markholmezza/nhanes-chd): a data audit and survey-weighted revalidation using NHANES
* [Predator odor and squirrel foraging](https://github.com/Markholmezza/squirrel-foraging-survival-analysis): a time-to-event analysis of a blocked field experiment

Outside of statistics, I play oboe and English horn.
